description: Static indicators for the October 2026 TensorLake npm and Cursor-distributed Claude Code extension incidents. No artifact is downloaded or executed. Extension version numbers alone are not malicious indicators.

sources.scope: npm tensorlake 0.5.144; lib/setup.mjs and lib/Math_Symbol.js. This is not a PyPI rule.

Tampered Cursor marketplace Anthropic.claude-code 2.1.312 and 2.1.313 for macOS and Windows; the advisory identifies both markers in extension.js. Same-version artifacts from other channels are not classified by version alone.

packageVersionRules.name: tensorlake
packageVersionRules.message: Confirmed affected TensorLake npm version from the 2026-10-08 ChainDrop incident. The release contains a malicious preinstall loader. Presence alone does not prove execution.

combinedIocs.message: Both published Cursor Claude Code SSH-backdoor markers occur in extension.js. This is code evidence, not a version-only match or proof of execution.
combinedIocs.recommendation: Stop using this extension pending review. Compare the code and distribution source with Cursor's 2026-10-29 advisory, updated 2026-10-30. If it ran, investigate that host; uninstalling the extension alone may leave persistence. This scanner does not inspect SSH configuration or remove the backdoor.
